description: Sabaragamuwa Province - The Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 02 of 2016
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an appropriation statute (Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 02 of 2016) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It details legal changes to budgetary allocations and financial limits, which falls squarely under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (new laws, acts, ordinances, regulations, amendments, and statutory instruments).
